$comment: PreToolUse guard for vibe-us-warm-bck-ops-hr. Blocks Edit/Write into any /template/ or /archive/ path (read-only per 01-product-studio/_rules). Exit code 2 denies the tool call and returns the reason to the model. Mirrors _shared/script/validator.py preflight().

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ti=d.get('tool_input',{}) or {}; p=(ti.get('file_path') or ti.get('notebook_path') or '').replace('\\\\','/'); block='/template/' in p or '/archive/' in p; sys.stderr.write('BLOCKED: '+p+' is read-only (template/ and archive/ are immutable; copy to input/ first).\n') if block else None; sys.exit(2 if block else 0)"
